headline: BFIU seeks content creator Salman Muqtadir's bank account details
summary: The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit has asked all commercial banks to submit Salman Muqtadir's account information and transaction history. The move comes amid questions raised at a monetary policy announcement event.
details: The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has requested comprehensive bank account and transaction details for content creator Salman Muqtadir from all commercial banks. The directive was issued on Wednesday, with banks asked to submit the information by the end of the day.

The BFIU's request coincided with the Bangladesh Bank's announcement of its monetary policy for October-December. While the central bank governor was absent due to official duties, Deputy Governor Habibur Rahman addressed journalists.

During the press conference, journalists inquired about the BFIU's action against Salman Muqtadir. The head of the BFIU, Ikhtiar Uddin Mohammad Mamun, was present but reportedly left the venue before the questions could be addressed.

Deputy Governor Habibur Rahman stated he would inform the BFIU and brief the governor about the situation, as no other BFIU officials present could provide answers regarding the content creator's bank accounts.
caption:
Bangladesh's financial intelligence unit has requested bank account details of popular content creator Salman Muqtadir. The move was confirmed amid questions at a central bank event.

The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has requested comprehensive bank account and transaction details for content creator Salman Muqtadir from all commercial banks. The directive was issued on Wednesday, with banks asked to submit the information by the end of the day.

The BFIU's request coincided with the Bangladesh Bank's announcement of its monetary policy for October-December. While the central bank governor was absent due to official duties, Deputy Governor Habibur Rahman addressed journalists.

During the press conference, journalists inquired about the BFIU's action against Salman Muqtadir. The head of the BFIU, Ikhtiar Uddin Mohammad Mamun, was present but reportedly left the venue before the questions could be addressed.

Deputy Governor Habibur Rahman stated he would inform the BFIU and brief the governor about the situation, as no other BFIU officials present could provide answers regarding the content creator's bank accounts.

headline_marked: DU [[restores Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall name]] at main gate
headline: DU restores Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall name at main gate
summary: The university is removing the 'Shaheed Osman Hadi Hall' sign to revert to the original name following a Senate decision.
details: Dhaka University is restoring the original name of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall at its main gate, removing the sign that read 'Shaheed Osman Hadi Hall'.
DU Pro-Vice-Chancellor (Administration) Professor Mohammed Almujaddade Alfasane confirmed the move, stating that a previous Senate decision to retain all old names is now being implemented.
The name change had occurred in December 2025, when the sign was erased and replaced to honor Osman Hadi, a spokesperson for Inqilab Moncho.
Following the replacement, the Dhaka University Central Students’ Union (DUCSU) had demanded that the hall be formally renamed after Hadi.
